lecture_title: SCAMPER — Seven Ways to Change a Thing
content:
Unit 3 opens. SCAMPER is presented as a checklist that works on a bad day — the opposite of waiting for inspiration.

CORE IDEA
SCAMPER is not inspiration. It is seven questions asked in order, and it works even on a day when you feel like you have no ideas.

1. The seven prompts. Substitute, Combine, Adapt, Modify, Put to another use, Eliminate, Rearrange.
2. Order matters less than completeness. Running all seven badly beats running two well — the value is in coverage.
3. Eliminate is the most productive and the least used. People add. Removing is where the surprises are.
4. Write before you judge. Fill all seven rows first. Evaluate afterwards, never during.

learning_objectives.statement: Eliminate is the most productive and the least used

active_learning_components.desc: What did laying out all four maps reveal about where your attention had been? Which branch had you avoided?
active_learning_components.rationale: Recall from memory, log closed, before any new input. Retrieval beats re-reading for retention.

active_learning_components.desc: Runs the full method in three and a half minutes on something with no stakes, so the structure is familiar before it meets the anchor.
One object everyone can see — a steel tiffin box, a college ID card, an autorickshaw. All seven prompts, called out, written on the board. You facilitate; the room supplies the ideas.

active_learning_components.type: All seven, on your own object
active_learning_components.desc: Each student picks any object in the room or in their bag. Printed SCAMPER grid, seven rows, minimum three ideas per row. Twenty-one ideas minimum.
Swap grids. Add one idea to each of your partner's seven rows. You will find their empty rows easily — everyone has one.
3 minutes. Pitch your best single SCAMPER output and name which prompt produced it.
Which prompt was hardest for you? That is your habit showing.

early_finisher_extension: Run SCAMPER on SCAMPER. What would you Eliminate from the method itself?

forward_link.say: These seven prompts are how you generate value-addition options for a commodity.
